title: 731. Find Pivot Index

examples.explanation: Left of index 3 sums to 11 and right also sums to 11.
Left of index 0 is 0 and right (1 + -1) is also 0.

hints: The right sum at i equals total minus left sum minus nums[i].
Sweep once keeping the left sum and compare against the implied right sum.
Return the first index that balances; return -1 when none does.
